headline: The soak that Chrome wouldn't run
lede: Batch 2's nine WATCH pilots have wanted a real soak since they shipped — and with no browser engine on the studio host, they never got one. This session moved the soak to the seam the seats actually live: each game's own brain driving its own sim in Node. 68 gates, two seconds, and it now runs on every PR.

notes.text: watchsoakcheck: all nine batch-2 predicates soaked for real — fuel-burn, fired+cities, v>0.3, digs, delivered, dug/ore/farm, score/pos windows — full runs to the win in 8 of 9 titles, determinism hashes, and honest notes where a sim doesn't vary by seed (no fake diversity banked).

Nine source pins tie every soak driver to its game's watching branch — a game that swaps its brain and forgets the gate goes red without needing Chrome. Registered in the CI static job: permanent PR coverage, not another browser-blocked todo.

The soak caught a trap in itself: OutRun's position counter is stage-local and resets at fork boundaries — a measurement window that crossed a stage compared apples to reset-odds. Fixed and documented, the way harnesses earn trust.
#1653 is down to one part: the 390px pill nudges still need a box that can render them. Everything else the issue asked for is shipped and gated.
